title: Continuity — on the beat
logline: For motion designers on X: Continuity's films now cut, hit and morph on the music — and prove it.

scenes.intent: Stake the claim on the first downbeat: motion that hears the beat.

beats.note: 'Motion that' wipes on with the boom
'hears the beat.' wipes on the next kick
'Motion that' steps to the grey on the last beat

scenes.motion: Two display lines wipe on, one per kick. On beat 3 the first line dims: rank by ink, on the beat. Hard cut on the bar.

scenes.intent: Show the machine listening: the beat grid of this very track, lighting beat by beat.

elements.note: a window with the track's bars
t0–t3: beat ticks, each brightens on its beat

scenes.motion: The window whips up on the downbeat; each beat tick steps to fg on its beat (ink, instant). Cut on the bar.

scenes.intent: What it does with the beat: cuts, hits, holds — each card whipping in on its kick.

beats.note: the morph starts on the bar-3 boom

elements.note: carries the cut: morphs into the stat tile

scenes.motion: Three cards whip in from the right on eighths (beats 0, ½, 1), blurred snap, squash. Hold. On the bar's boom (beat 4) the last card carries the cut into the stat tile.

scenes.intent: The proof, as a number: the render's own audio lands within milliseconds of the picture.

text.label: audio vs picture, measured on the render

elements.note: arrives from the card via the morph

scenes.motion: The tile lands from the morph with its value; the camera's push carries the hold. Cut on the bar.

scenes.intent: The feel, in three words: whip, drift, land — each word doing what it says on a beat.
scenes.motion: Each word whips in on its beat with squash and stretch; motion blur on the snap. Cut on the bar.

scenes.intent: The wordmark becomes the mark on the downbeat; the line lands; hold.

elements.note: a Morph: the word's outline → the mark

scenes.motion: The outline of 'Continuity' sits centred; on beat 1 it morphs into the mark (expressive) and slides left; the wordmark types on beat 3; the line wipes on beat 4 (the next bar). 3% push.
